name: Boma–Badingilo Migratory Landscape
description: In South Sudan, where the Sudd wetlands meet open savanna, Boma and Badingilo National Parks and their surrounding floodplains host one of Earth's largest land animal migrations. An estimated six million White-eared Kob, Tiang and Mongalla Gazelle roam a nearly roadless landscape, alongside elephants, lions and cheetahs. Murle, Dinka, Nuer and other peoples have herded and farmed here for centuries.
